rules.rationale: Android 16 calls hw_module_exists for the bst variant after all hardware/property variants fail and before the default variant, exactly preserving A13 precedence while retaining current APEX/VNDK path handling.
rules.necessity: Required so BlueStacks passthrough HALs are selected instead of generic default modules when no hardware-specific variant matches.
rules.performance: At most one additional access check during legacy HAL module discovery; no steady-state HAL-call overhead.
rules.security: Changes dynamic module selection. Only trusted system/vendor/odm HAL directories are searched and normal module ID validation remains active.
validation_evidence: A13 and Android-16 hw_get_module_by_class ordering was compared; target commit e2305d5c adds only the bst fallback and documentation.

rules.rationale: A13 disabled the default gralloc by renaming its Android.mk because App Player uses goldfish-opengl-pie/system/gralloc. Android 16 tracks the legacy gralloc sources but no Android.mk or Android.bp in modules/gralloc, so the module remains disabled without carrying an obsolete .orig file.
rules.necessity: Required to avoid building or selecting a second generic gralloc implementation alongside the external goldfish driver.
rules.performance: Avoids duplicate build output and prevents accidental runtime selection of the non-accelerated/default gralloc.
rules.security: Reduces graphics module ambiguity; the selected goldfish gralloc remains subject to its own ABI and buffer-validation review.
validation_evidence: git ls-files in Android-16 modules/gralloc contains source files only and no build definition; the external goldfish-opengl-pie integration is retained by the target build configuration.
